messages:
deploybot: [2247503000] Starting build pipeline for tag v1.9.3-staging (commit: abcdef1234) -> environment: staging. Steps: lint, unit, integration, e2e. notifying: #eng-releases.
alex: saw the notification, watching the pipeline.
maya: oncall heads-up — will jump in if anything flakes.
sam: FYI, this release pins protobuf 3.11 -> 3.14 in the runtime shim (PR #492).
leo: noted. that protobuf bump has caused lint warnings in past runs.
deploybot: [2247503065] LINT step failed (exit 1). Summary: 3 errors, 7 warnings. Check logs: https://ci.internal/runs/2247503000/logs/lint
alex: ugh the lint failure looks like the generated grpc stubs changed. quick grep: `grpc/runner.pb.go: missing generated comment`
maya: can we auto-fix or is this a codegen regression?
sam: looks like codegen output changed due to protobuf bump — not our source. I propose pinning to protobuf 3.11 for this deploy to keep CI green, and file a follow-up RFC to adopt 3.14 with migration PRs.
leo: alternative is to accept lint failures by pinning the lint rule for generated files (add //nolint) but i prefer a dependency pin — safer for release window.
alex: +1 on pinning dependency for staging snapshot and doing a proper migration. we should avoid touching lint rules in this change window.
maya: agree. @sam can you open a quickfix PR to revert the bump in the release branch? If not, we can branch from commit abcdef1234 and cherry-pick an explicit pin.
sam: creating hotfix branch now: `git checkout -b hotfix/pin-protobuf-3.11 && git revert --no-commit <commit-hash-with-bump>` — will push in a minute.
qa-bot: automated note: rerun required after dependency pin. ETA for full pipeline ~ 12m after push.
deploybot: [2247503220] Notification: push detected on branch hotfix/pin-protobuf-3.11 (commit: bcd234ef). Triggering pipeline.
deploybot: [2247503285] UNIT tests: all passed.
leo: nice. unit stable.
alex: integration running. I'll watch for timeouts.
maya: tagging this thread as :hold: for release decision — suggests we hold the staging promotion until we confirm canary tomorrow morning.
sam: integration passed. e2e starting.
deploybot: [2247503360] E2E: failed on scenario `auth/session-refresh` — flake? failing stacktrace: ```timeout waiting for cookie refresh; stack: auth/refresh_test.go:142: expected 200 got 504```
alex: that looks unrelated to the protobuf change. maybe an infra flake in the test runner.
maya: agree, but we should be conservative. recommend: hold rollout, open a postmortem if this repeats, and run a targeted e2e rerun for that scenario.
leo: propose two-step decision: 1) pin protobuf and re-run full pipeline (we did), 2) mark this staging build as BLOCKED awaiting e2e investigation, do not promote to canary or prod.
sam: done the pin PR and confirmed lint/unit/integration green; e2e failed once. I'll re-run just the failing e2e suite and attach logs.
deploybot: [2247503385] E2E rerun triggered for `auth/session-refresh` (job 2247503385).
qa-bot: scheduled targeted rerun, results expected in ~3m.
alex: if rerun passes, we can schedule a small canary tomorrow in the 09:00-10:00 PDT change window. If it fails again, we either roll back the unrelated change that introduced flakiness or delay the release until next window.
maya: +1. put a note in the release notes draft: "staging build blocked due to intermittent auth e2e; dependency pin applied for staging snapshot; follow-up migration planned."
leo: I'll update the release-notes/drafts with that exact wording and link this thread.
sam: rerun passed ✅ — targeted e2e now green.
deploybot: [2247503390] STATUS: pipeline succeeded for hotfix/pin-protobuf-3.11 (commit: bcd234ef). All checks green.
alex: since the root e2e flake seems transient and the pin fixed lint, i recommend we leave the staging promotion on HOLD until we confirm canary in next window. We should avoid surprise rollouts outside the change window.
maya: agree. decision: HOLD staging promotion; no canary today; schedule canary for 2025-03-21 09:00 PDT change window. Sam to prepare canary config and run smoke before cutover.
sam: will prepare canary and a rollback playbook (steps and commit/tag to revert). I'll also add a short checklist in the release notes: rollback tag -> v1.9.2-hotfix.
leo: adding action items: 1) sam: push canary config + playbook, 2) alex: coordinate on-call for canary window, 3) maya: finalize release notes and post-mortem if auth e2e recurs.
alex: acknowledged. marking this thread as resolved for now — status: hold, next action: canary prep. :white_check_mark:
deploybot: [2247503390] Thread closed by user action.
